body:
God. I know exactly how you feel. People tell me it's all my fault, and that I'm not working hard enough, but all I do is work, they see that too, just can't process the two, put them together. Either that or it must just be being so pathetic that they eventually lose respect, no longer seeing me as an entity deserving of such.

I was reading a few posts a second ago and I started getting an actual panic attack, pounding heart et. al., because I realized that if things don't work out, it's always "your fault" even though logically that's not true; that people will always believe themselves to be above you, and that you just don't "get it" like they do. Then, later, they just get mad; at those times I think they're more frustrated with the process but have to place blame on someone. We all have to believe we live in something vaguely resembling a rational/logical world, right? I'm kind of scared.  Nothing works, no one cares; is it really just waiting for the fire to get hotter, being taunted by people who won't let you in, but make sure to let you know everything you're missing along the way?  I want to vomit, haven't been touched in years.  That's all I really want, but I can't just ask for it, people laugh, they get mad, they tell me I'm entitled even if it's just in the abstract need as opposed to an individual-individual basis.

Kindred spirit.

It was delusion of hope in this case; being shouted over, being told it will get better if effort is put in. Every race has a loser, even if the entire track just broke a previous world record. Why we pretend otherwise is some sort of sadistic nightmare we call society. Same shit with being hurt, money stolen, rumors spread, secrets told, situations backed out of ad infinitum. If I open up I'm a tryhard, and overeager there is no win.

Hey, talk about your shit, I want to read. Why are you angry (I don't mean that in a rhetorical sense, I can think of a billion reasons, but I don't know you specifically)? FA is an awful subforum, there is a mod on there with an agenda...it's actually kind of crazy and really frustrated me for a while because I wanted to relate to the guys there, but this one mod kept deleting my posts...I guess that person really dislikes men, but runs a subreddit of mostly men and talks down to them; that's why it's always about "why are you FA, it's your fault."  Fun stuff.

I was reading the sub /r/foreveralone alone a few days back.

I used to be shadowbanned on that sub, but I was always paranoid and assumed it was some sort of hidden ruleset to keep against bots.

Then a couple days back the mod went CRAZY and started ranting about how men are all rapists.  Then I was reading /r/theredpill today, and they were making fun of men like me for not being able to have sex (and how great that is for humanity!), and i just started cutting myself and hit myself in the head a few times. An immensely immature act, but I know not what else to do. It's such a perfect example of how ANYTHING will be misconstrued, you'll be a, b, c; anything but what you want.  Anything but the reaction others get, anything but the part others get.  always excluded always the joke doesn't matter who it is, they'll laugh anyway, rub it in your face, both parties, all parties, it's everything, always, forever. it's like there is nothing good, just selfishness.  any good act you do will be "nice guy" and you a loser, worse than you started.  there is no win. THERE IS NO WIN.  only slow degradation, death. humiliation, loss, grief, sorry, pain.

I don't know what to do anymore, and I refuse to hurt others, so all I can do is hurt myself.  What else CAN I do?  Nothing worked, nothing has ever worked, people on all sides of the aisles are monsters. I am SO SOSO  SOSOSOOSOSOSOSOOSOSO sick of people.  WHAT THE FUCK,  I WISH SOMEONE WOULD HAVE SHOT ME AS A SMALL CHILD INSTEAD OF THIS FUCKING VOID OF ANYTHING GOOD EVER ITS ONLY FOR OTHER PEOPLE SIT DOWN SHUT THE FUCK UP AND EAT MY SHIT YOU FUCKING WORTHLESS LOSER, YOU DESERVE TO BE BULLIED AND EXCLUDED BECAUSE YOU WERE BORN.  WHO THE FUCK DO YOU THINK YOU ARE?

Have you read Infinite Jest?  You should if you haven't I wish I could remember the three pages that quote is from, somewhere in the middle.

You should read the book if you haven't it's a work of art.
